sources.evaluated: Human leukocyte primary IG assays four pyrosequencing/six bisulfite CpGs versus secondary MEG3 assays. Authors explicitly state their 450K imprinting panel includes MEG3:TSS but not MEG3/DLK1:IG-DMR. This is assay/panel-specific contrary evidence and cannot prove no whole IG coverage across all annotations.

sources.interpretation_limit: Source demonstrates normal bulk methylation can coexist with irregular non-differential methylation; bulk array values alone cannot establish allelic imprinting. Tissue- and assay-dependent definition matters.
